facts.text: Under the Hood Advantage Program, full-time Maryland students from households with an adjusted gross income of $50,000 or less have their full tuition covered without loans for up to four years after federal grants and scholarships.

sources.title: Hood College Launches 'Hood Advantage Program' for Students in Maryland
sources.quote: By covering remaining tuition costs after federal grants and scholarships, qualifying students are guaranteed to have their tuition covered each year without loans for up to four years.

sources.title: Hood College Launches 'Hood Advantage Program' for Students in Maryland
sources.quote: Live in a household with an adjusted gross income of $50,000 or less.
